claims.text: The dataset used consists of tweets categorized into harassment and non-harassment, with sub-categories of indirect harassment, sexual harassment, and physical harassment.
The dataset is divided into a training set, validation set, and test set, and is noted to be imbalanced, particularly in the indirect and physical harassment categories.
Data augmentation techniques, including back-translation, were applied to address the imbalance in the dataset.
